sourceRecords.title: Contract fixture for the no-tax branch of the state rule-pack contract; not an authority and not a jurisdiction
sourceRecords.publisher: Lifetime Tax Strategy Lab contract fixture
sourceRecords.retrievalNote: This is a CONTRACT FIXTURE, not a transcription of any authority. It exists so the sourced-zero branch of the contract is exercised by a pack that STATES the absence outright, which is what a real no-tax pack would have to do and what no shipped jurisdiction pack currently does. It declares the jurisdiction state:QQ, which is not a jurisdiction, so this pack cannot resolve for any real household however its declared years are read, and its ruleStatus is user-hypothetical-law rather than enacted law. No figure or wording here is, or may become, a figure or wording in a shipped jurisdiction pack.

supportedFeatures.label: Fixture jurisdiction stating that it imposes no individual income tax
supportedFeatures.reason: The fixture authority states the absence outright rather than leaving it to be derived, so the pack may declare imposesIndividualIncomeTax false, carry the authority that states it, and produce a valued record of zero carrying that citation rather than a blank, a dash or an unattributed zero.

unsupportedFeatures.label: Every provision this fixture does not carry
unsupportedFeatures.reason: A fixture carries exactly the branch it exists to exercise and nothing else. No result derived from it describes any real jurisdiction.
unsupportedFeatures.successorFeature: A real jurisdiction pack transcribed from that jurisdiction's own retrieved authority.

unsupportedFeatures.label: Any real jurisdiction
unsupportedFeatures.reason: The declared jurisdiction state:QQ is not a jurisdiction, so this pack cannot resolve for a real household.

expiryPolicy.reason: A fixture expiry far outside any household's planning horizon, so the fixture never expires mid-suite and never masks a real pack's expiry.
